analysis: M1-M8 low-throttle command echo and RPM response timing
source_sha256_manifest_method: sha256sum matching CSV files, sort by full output line, then sha256sum the sorted manifest

method.command_apply_onset: Time from first active-phase host row to first telemetry row where selected-motor applied throttle matches the request within 0.002.
method.rpm_onset: Time from first active-phase host row to first selected-motor RPM sample with requested sign and magnitude at least 10% of its final-20-row steady median.
method.command_apply_zero: Time from first neutral-after host row to first telemetry row where selected-motor applied throttle magnitude is below 0.001.
method.rpm_below_10_percent: Time from applied zero to the first three consecutive RPM samples below 10% of the active steady magnitude.

deadband_bound.conclusion: The in-water rotation threshold is below 5% for all eight motors in this supply/load condition. The force deadband is not identified.

limitations: Timing resolution is limited by the 50 ms host/telemetry cycle.
RPM telemetry has quantization and isolated spikes, especially during spin-down.
Four runs did not contain three consecutive below-10% samples before their log ended.
No load-cell data exists for the current vehicle, so RPM timing is not thrust timing.
confidence: medium for command echo and RPM onset; low-to-medium for spin-down timing; force response remains unmeasured
